quantization.scheme: per-outline bounding-box centre + per-outline int16 scale
dequantize: raDeg  = outlineRaMid[o]  + pointRa[p]  * outlineRaScale[o]   // then wrap into [0,360)
quantization.note: RA is unwrapped per outline before quantizing so shapes straddling RA = 0 stay contiguous; dequantized RA may fall slightly outside [0,360) and must be wrapped.

traversal: for each outline o: for r in [outlineRingStart[o], +outlineRingCount[o]): draw the closed polyline pointRa/pointDec[ringPointStart[r] .. +ringPointCount[r]]

fields.name: outlineRaMid
fields.note: RA of the outline bounding-box centre

fields.name: outlineDecMid
fields.note: Dec of the outline bounding-box centre

fields.name: outlineRingStart
fields.note: first ring index for this outline

fields.name: outlineRingCount
fields.note: number of rings in this outline

fields.name: ringPointStart
fields.note: first point index for this ring

fields.name: ringPointCount
fields.note: number of points in this ring

methodology: Isophote contours traced in Aladin Sky Atlas over DSS2 Color at three brightness levels (lv1 faintest .. lv3 brightest), simplified with shapely. See outlines/metodology.txt in the OpenNGC source.
acknowledgement: This research has made use of "Aladin sky atlas" developed at CDS, Strasbourg Observatory, France.
